definition: For fundamental discriminants d with 1<|d|<=X and gcd(d,11)=1, evaluate the exact finite raw Gram matrix G_X(p,q)=|D(X)|^(-1) sum_d chi_d(p)chi_d(q), its centered covariance, and the mean, second moment, and variance of sum_p a_p(E)chi_d(p)/sqrt(p) at good primes p,q<=43.

exact_coordinate_formulas.centered_variance: Var(W)=sum_i a_i^2 H_ii/(N^2 p_i) + sum_{i<j} (2 a_i a_j H_ij/(N^2 p_i p_j)) sqrt(p_i p_j).
exact_coordinate_formulas.marginal_counts: positive_i=(R_ii+s_i)/2, negative_i=(R_ii-s_i)/2, zero_i=N-R_ii; mean chi_i=s_i/N, local density_i=R_ii/N, asymptotic comparator_i=p_i/(p_i+1), and density error_i=R_ii/N-p_i/(p_i+1).
exact_coordinate_formulas.notation: For aligned indices i,j, let p_i=primes[i], a_i=traces[i], s_i=character_sums[i], R_ij=raw_gram.numerators[i][j], H_ij=centered_covariance.numerators[i][j], and N=discriminant_count.
exact_coordinate_formulas.reconstruction: The aligned integer sufficient statistics and these formulas reconstruct every exact multiquadratic mean, second-moment, and centered-variance coordinate; the three stored decimals use the positive real embedding only for display.
exact_coordinate_formulas.second_moment: E[W^2]=sum_i a_i^2 R_ii/(N p_i) + sum_{i<j} (2 a_i a_j R_ij/(N p_i p_j)) sqrt(p_i p_j).

exact_identities.centered_covariance: Cov=V^T(N I-1 1^T)V/N^2, hence Cov is positive semidefinite.
exact_identities.moment_coordinates: Distinct squarefree radicands are exact multiquadratic basis coordinates; decimal displays use the positive real embedding.
exact_identities.raw_gram: G=V^T V/N for V[d,p]=chi_d(p), hence G is positive semidefinite.

family_definition: fundamental discriminants d with 1<|d|<=X and gcd(d,11)=1; uniform measure; no root-number split
